structureFacts: Growth drivers cited: automotive, construction, and general industrial demand; urbanization and infrastructure development; automation adoption; 'Make in India' and domestic manufacturing policy support

A meaningful sub-set of Indian 'manufacturers' in this space actually operate as exclusive-agency/distribution-and-integration businesses for international OEM brands, layered with local service and light engineering, rather than as ground-up equipment OEMs themselves — this segment file frames the value chain to fit that agency/integration model, not a pure-manufacturer model

In an agency/integration model, market position is better read as a 'channel/service' player benefiting from end-user capex growth in downstream sectors, rather than as a machine-building competitor to Trumpf/Bystronic/LVD
